model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different language families on various models, with the categories on the horizontal axis labeled as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and ranges from 0 to 30 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 5 and minor ticks at intervals of 1. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group representing a language family and containing five bars corresponding to different models: XLM-L2 (blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (green), mBERT-B2 (pink), and XLM-B2 (red). The height of each bar represents the effect value, and error bars are shown extending from the top of each bar. The models are distinguished by different colors, as indicated by the legend. The bars within each group are consistently ordered according to the legend, and the groups are presented in the order listed on the horizontal axis, with no apparent sorting by effect value. The effect values range from approximately 0 to 25, with the highest values observed for the IE-Indic family across most models.
